rendered_text: {"text":"The proposed update changes the cache lifetime from five minutes to fifteen minutes. A benchmark conducted over twenty-four hours observed eighteen percent fewer origin requests. However, the benchmark did not measure stale-read incidence, so its result is not complete evidence for every aspect of a broader rollout. Given that explicit limitation, the appropriately bounded recommendation is to approve only a canary deployment and require stale-read telemetry before any broader rollout."}
